subject: Role termination & closeout plan for Liana Park
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Role termination & closeout plan for Liana Park

Team —

I need to escalate a sensitive personnel action and align on a coordinated closeout. After multiple performance improvement conversations over the past six months and a recent HR review, I am recommending involuntary termination for Liana Park (Data Engineer, IC-3). Proposed effective date: 2026-05-22 EOD.

High-level summary:
- Performance: missed three consecutive sprint deliverables, repeated missed 1:1s, and documented inability to meet quality thresholds despite coaching.
- Risk: Liana has access to multiple production datasets and service accounts; we need an access cutoff plan.
- Tone: we want to be compassionate, compliant, and minimize operational risk.

Immediate asks:
1) Mina — please confirm legal/benefits checklist and recommended severance range; attached is a draft termination letter and my final pay calc.
2) Laura — inventory of repositories, service accounts, and active tickets Liana owns. Prioritize anything customer-facing.
3) Dev — prepare a timed access revocation playbook (GitHub, GCP, internal tools) and confirm who will run the offboarding steps.

Attachments: proposed_termination_letter_draft.pdf, final_pay_calculation.xlsx, offboarding_checklist.pdf

I realize this is short notice; happy to jump on a call. If legal needs to review, please loop counsel and mark any edits in the letter.

Thanks —
Markus
VP, Data Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Employment Law LLP <counsel@employmentlaw.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Role termination & closeout plan for Liana Park

Markus —

Acknowledged. I reviewed the draft and looped counsel for quick review (cc'd). A few items to confirm before we send anything to the employee:

1) Effective termination date and last day for payroll/benefits (proposed 2026-05-22 EOD).
2) Whether we will offer a severance package and the number of weeks (see attached final_pay_calculation.xlsx for suggested options).
3) Return of company property (we should include a staging plan for laptop, badge, phone).
4) Whether we want a 30- or 60-minute in-person/Zoom meeting to deliver the message (I recommend one private Zoom).

I've attached the standard offboarding_checklist.pdf with recommended timing for access revocation and final pay timelines. Counsel: please review the draft letter and confirm we can proceed with the proposed severance note on page 2.

I will hold on the notice to Liana until legal OKs and you confirm the meeting time. If we move forward on 5/22, please provide the list of technical accesses Laura/Dev mentioned by EOD today so we can schedule revocation windows with IT.

— Mina
Senior HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Role termination & closeout plan for Liana Park

Thanks team —

I pulled together an initial inventory below (high priority items first):

- GitHub: repo access to data-pipelines, model-training, and shared analytics. Liana is a repo admin on data-pipelines.
- GCP: service account data-analytics-prod (has read/write to bucket redwood-prod-data).
- Tickets: three active high-priority JIRA issues assigned to Liana (RED-358, RED-412, RED-478) — RED-358 is customer-impacting.
- Notebooks: private BigQuery notebooks under Liana's account with ad-hoc queries against PII-sampled tables.

Suggested access revocation sequence (to minimize customer impact):
1) Pause commits & PR merges to the data-pipelines repo and reassign admin to Dev Patel.
2) Immediately rotate keys for the service account after snapshotting current configs.
3) Reassign tickets RED-358/412 to Laura and flag RED-358 for on-call cover.

I can have a detailed export of all reachable repos and service accounts by 16:00 today. For the meeting delivery: I support a short HR-led call; I will join to cover product continuity and reassignments.

— Laura
Director, Data Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Liana Park <liana.park@example.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-21T14:37:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps — meeting to discuss role changes

Liana —

Thank you for speaking with HR today. We want to follow up with a short meeting to review changes to your role and next steps. The purpose of the call is to go over final pay, return of equipment, and the separation timeline.

Please schedule a 30-minute slot with Mina (mina.haddad@redwood.com) using this link: https://redwood.calendar/meetings/mina/offboard. We have prepared a separation packet that includes the termination letter and an agreement to return company property. For your convenience there is a DocuSign link to the separation agreement: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABCDEF-termination-agreement (please do not sign until you have spoken with HR).

High-level items we will cover on the call:
- Final pay and any severance options
- Health benefits continuation and COBRA timelines
- Company property return (laptop, badge, phone) and prepaid shipping label if needed
- Access deactivation timing and point of contact for project transition

If you have documentation you want us to consider, please bring it to the meeting. Mina will be the primary point for questions on benefits and next steps.

Regards —
Markus
VP, Data Platform
Redwood Inference
